statement_nl: Fix n >= 3 and assume as induction hypothesis that the theorem already holds for every size m with 2 <= m < n. Let s be any sign sequence of length n-1, and write f(s)=F(s) for the theorem's counting function. Applying L2 to s gives the exact decomposition F(s) = sum over j in V(s) of binomial(n-1,j-1) times left_count(j) times right_count(j), where V(s) is the valley set of s.
